mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the locus of all commodity combinations that yield the same level of satisfaction."
Indifference Curve An indifference curve is the locus of all commodity combinations that yield the same level of satisfaction.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical statement of the physical relationship given by technology, between a firm's input of productive resources and its output of goods and services per unit of time."

The production function is a mathematical statement of the physical relationship given by technology, between a firm's input of productive resources and its output of goods and services per unit of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the crux of partial equilibrium analysis."
The ceteris paribus assumption is the crux of partial equilibrium analysis.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the distinct share of the national income received by the people, as agents of production per Unit of time, as a reward for the unique functions rendered by them through their productive services."

Functional distribution refers to the distinct share of the national income received by the people, as agents of production per Unit of time, as a reward for the unique functions rendered by them through their productive services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered to be technical externalities."
Almost all externalities are considered to be technical externalities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical technique which involves the allocation of limited resources in an optimal manner, on the basis of a given criterion of optimality."
Linear programming is a mathematical technique which involves the allocation of limited resources in an optimal manner, on the basis of a given criterion of optimality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the lucky consumers who get the loans at the cheaper interest rate."
The people who gain are the lucky consumers who get the loans at the cheaper interest rate.

The TC curve is derived by superimposing the curve showing advertising cost, on the original TC (excluding advertising curve).

Simplex method is the most important tool that had been developed to solve linear programming problems.

The implicit functional form is defined as: 𝑄 = 𝑓(𝑋1, 𝑋2 0).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the behaviour of measurable quantities and with the relationship between two or more of these quantities such as wages, prices, national income and employment."
Economics is concerned with the behaviour of measurable quantities and with the relationship between two or more of these quantities such as wages, prices, national income and employment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of generating a new idea and innovation is the act of putting the new idea into practical use."
Invention is the act of generating a new idea and innovation is the act of putting the new idea into practical use.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a payment for a factor of production (e.g., land) that does not change the amount of the factor that is supplied."
An economic rent is a payment for a factor of production (e.g., land) that does not change the amount of the factor that is supplied.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extensive study of a number of economic variables and elements, their interrelations and interdependences for understanding the working of the economic systems as a whole."

General equilibrium analysis is an extensive study of a number of economic variables and elements, their interrelations and interdependences for understanding the working of the economic systems as a whole.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the market value of outstanding equity shares divided by the book value of the assets of a firm."
The valuation ratio is the market value of outstanding equity shares divided by the book value of the assets of a firm.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a model of oligopoly in which firms produce a homogeneous good, and each firm takes the price of competitors fixed when deciding what price to charge."
The Bertrand model is a model of oligopoly in which firms produce a homogeneous good, and each firm takes the price of competitors fixed when deciding what price to charge.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of oligopoly, characterized by two primary corporations operating in a market or industry, producing the same or similar goods and services."
A duopoly is a type of oligopoly, characterized by two primary corporations operating in a market or industry, producing the same or similar goods and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the demand curve for a factor of production by an individual firm."
MRP (Marginal Revenue Productivity) curve is the demand curve for a factor of production by an individual firm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result, not a cause, because demand for land is a derived demand."
High rent is a result, not a cause, because demand for land is a derived demand.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the way total output, income, or wealth is distributed among individuals or among the factors of production such as labour, land, and capital."
Distribution refers to the way total output, income, or wealth is distributed among individuals or among the factors of production such as labour, land, and capital.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of price and given by Qd = Qd(P), thus the inverse demand function is P = P(Qd)."
Market demand is a function of price and given by Qd = Qd(P), thus the inverse demand function is P = P(Qd).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a locus of points of tangency of the isoquants of the two firms which produce X and Y."
The contract curve is a locus of points of tangency of the isoquants of the two firms which produce X and Y.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Nash equilibrium where the price equals the perfectly competitive price as long as there are two or more firms in the market."
The Bertrand equilibrium is a Nash equilibrium where the price equals the perfectly competitive price as long as there are two or more firms in the market.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of the equilibrium position of an individual, a firm, an industry or a group of industries viewed in seclusion."
Partial equilibrium is the study of the equilibrium position of an individual, a firm, an industry or a group of industries viewed in seclusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Nash equilibrium where each firm correctly assumes that its competitors behave optimally."
The Cournot equilibrium is a Nash equilibrium where each firm correctly assumes that its competitors behave optimally.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the profit function."
The growth function is derived from the profit function.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a market that is characterized by one firm or individual, a monopolist, on the supply side and one firm or individual, a monopsonist, on the demand side."
Bilateral Monopoly A bilateral monopoly is a market that is characterized by one firm or individual, a monopolist, on the supply side and one firm or individual, a monopsonist, on the demand side.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the return on their investment."
High wages are the return on their investment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the payment of the opportunity cost of capital the firm's owners provide to the firm."
Profit is the payment of the opportunity cost of capital the firm's owners provide to the firm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as secondary factor of production as it can be manipulated by economic activities."
Capital is regarded as secondary factor of production as it can be manipulated by economic activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the quantity of the output turned out by the use of factor or factors of production."
Productivity means the quantity of the output turned out by the use of factor or factors of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the evaluation of alternative economic situations from the point of view of the society's well-being."
Welfare economics is concerned with the evaluation of alternative economic situations from the point of view of the society's well-being.
